mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be plain boiled potatoes, a starchy meal high in rapidly available carbohydrates with limited fiber after peeling, which can raise blood sugar levels relatively quickly in someone with diabetes. It is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for whole grain or high-fiber alternatives instead, such as barley, lentils, or sweet potato with skin.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: Four plain boiled peeled potatoes served without visible toppings or sauces.
